assertion.statement: The actual nth formal quotient over Fprime is identified with pi^n O_Fprime/pi^(n+1) O_Fprime, equivariantly for Gal(Fprime/F).
assertion.objects: The actual elliptic formal group over the base local ring, base-defined parameter and finite unramified extension.
assertion.hypotheses: Use the formal completion of the Neron identity at zero, identified by a base minimal Weierstrass parameter; unramified extension preserves this parameter and minimality.
assertion.parameter_range: All prime characteristics and all extension degrees r>=1.
assertion.uniformity: No restriction that r be prime to the characteristic.
assertion.constants: No quantitative bound or division by r.
assertion.normalizations: The group acts on coefficients and fixes pi and the parameter definition.
assertion.exceptional_cases: The new local finite-field proof separately establishes normal-basis and cohomology conclusions.
assertion.limit_order: Compute trace and Frobenius kernels for the finite field extension before applying to each formal quotient.

use.reason: Imports only the formal-filtration identification into the actual finite-field application, not the outgoing H1 conclusion.
